meta.label: v2 Earth thermal layer and gates; gate statuses are PASS, FAIL or NOT TESTED
limits: Earth thermal layers are MODIS 8-day 1 km land surface temperature aggregated to 6 km; they are skin temperatures at satellite overpass times.
Comparison is by percentile rank inside each body's own set, never by absolute value.
Moon has 2 positives, so a Moon layer-2 recall is NOT TESTED.
G2(a) cannot be met by construction under a best-of-35-tiles score; G2(b) passes by chance about 83% of the time. See ENGINE_AUDIT.md.
Under the pre-registered QC rule, tiles in central Australia, Indonesia, the Amazon and much of the high latitudes have no thermal value and are not scored.
